status: Assistant-proposed relevance links for pilot review; not SME-reviewed
scope: Mussel research pilot; links do not establish designer adoption, a completed test or equivalence to SC-08.

links.rationale: The workshop asks how substrate composition, heterogeneity and stability influence mussels and other taxa. SC-08 proposes a narrower local substrate-stability/persistence hypothesis within this topic.
This question concerns interventions that shape channel substrates. It supplies restoration context for the pilot; a specific feature-to-response link still needs evidence.
Mussel responses to side-channel connectivity may matter to local applicability. Connectivity effects are broader than, and not equivalent to, SC-08.
The workshop also asks about adverse fish/mussel effects of water-level management. This is a separate question for consideration, not a result established by the current science sample.
